items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I started working with Al Denny's band

ctx.x: They told me to take a solo and I just went on and so they said, "Oh, man, he can read and fake. Man, we got -- man, why didn't you say something. Why were you sitting down there for?" You know. So that -- I started working with Al Denny's band and then I worked with Al Denny up until a fellow came to town named Lee Dare (PHONETIC). He was looking for some musicians. Used to be some brothers called the Gray Brothers -- they had a band.
